fact: The CMSS (Caisse Malienne de Securite Sociale) presented a digital pension payment scheme whose pilot with the Banque de Developpement du Mali was concluded as conclusive and is ready for phased rollout to other partner banks, with payment orders issued digitally through to settlement.
The document refers to the success of the CMSS's mobile payment of pensions, which the bank payment scheme follows; it gives no date or figures for the mobile payments.

CANAM launched on 7 May 2026 digital prior-authorisation requests under the AMO, with health facilities transmitting scanned patient files to CANAM through the AMO Anywhere information system and CANAM doctors returning decisions through it; several facilities have integrated it and others are being deployed.

The World Bank paper says the unified social registry built under the Jigiséméjiri project, holding nearly 1.2 million households at the project's close, has been used by several programs as a common targeting tool.

The paper says the RSU, holding over 60,000 poor households and almost 75,000 by March 2018, was used to identify beneficiaries of the labor-intensive public works program (launched September 2018) and the income-generating activities (launched October 2017), with RSU households given priority.
